item.title: Saturday Live Music at Spicy Vines feat. Jeremy Gorman Project — Sat Aug 1, 3:00 PM — Spicy Vines
item.description:
Where unforgettable wines, live music, and good vibes come together. Join us every Saturday from 3–6 PM at Spicy Vines for a tasting room experience like no other — where top local musicians from across the Bay Area meet our award-winning small-lot wines. From Rock & Roll and Blues to Jazz, Bluegrass, and Americana, each weekend brings new sounds and new reasons to raise a glass. The Jeremy Gorman Project Jeremy Gorman is a versatile guitarist and singer-songwriter whose soulful blend of rock, blues, folk, and jam-band influences creates music that’s both timeless and alive. With roots in New Orleans and a musical journey that’s taken him across genres and stages, Jeremy delivers heartfelt performances full of groove, grit, and spirit. Details No cover. Walk-ins are welcome, but this event tends to fill up quickly, so we recommend making a reservation. We are dog and family friendly!
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: Walnut Creek Jazz Band featuring Joyce Grant — Sun Aug 2, 7:00 PM — Empress Theatre
item.description:
A full big band. A powerhouse vocalist. A beautiful theatre. Dinner next door before the show. This is the perfect Sunday evening out in downtown Vallejo. Join us at the historic Empress Theatre for the Walnut Creek Jazz Band featuring Joyce Grant, an evening of big band swing, jazz, blues, R&B, soul, and classic American songbook favorites.
Joyce Grant is one of the Bay Area’s most beloved vocalists, known for her warm stage presence, rich tone, and deep musical storytelling. Often described as having a voice like “dark honey,” Joyce brings elegance, soul, humor, and heart to every performance. Her style moves easily from jazz and blues to R&B, funk, gospel colors, and big band classics.
Joyce also carries a remarkable connection to American music history: she is the great-great-niece of ragtime legend Scott Joplin. item.title: National Lighthouse Day 2026 — Fri Aug 7, 7:30 PM — Point Reyes National Seashore
item.description: Experience the historic Point Reyes Lighthouse as it appeared a century ago. On this special evening, Point Reyes National Seashore will illuminate and rotate the 156-year old Fresnel lens, giving visitors a rare opportunity to witness history in motion. The Lighthouse Visitor Center will be open with exhibits, retail offerings, and light refreshments for sale. Throughout the evening, staff will be available to answer questions, share the history of the lighthouse, and provide interpretive programs for visitors of all ages. Important Event Information: Carpooling is encouraged, as parking is very limited and may fill early—please plan to arrive ahead of time. The Drakes Beach and South Beach parking lots are great options to carpool from. ADA parking is limited. If you anticipate needing an ADA space, please contact the park in advance to discuss availability. Bring a flashlight or headlamp; red‑light options are preferred to reduce night‑vision disruption. This year's theme is "Where Joy Takes Root," promising cheer, creativity, and community for all! Since 1973, the Gravenstein Apple Fair has brought together farmers, families, musicians, artists, and food lovers to celebrate the agricultural roots of Sonoma County. Gather with us to enjoy all things apple, the best local food and drink, top regional music, ag-inspired fun for all ages, Artisan Tasting Grove, VIP Lounge, and much more! Hailed as Bohemian’s Best Festival since 2019, Best Art Event 2026, and Best Charity Event 2026, the Fair has also been 95% Zero Waste since 2018. Proceeds benefit the nonprofit Sonoma County Farm Trails.

item.title: Movement and Stillness Art Reception with Alexis Greenberg and Debra Owen — Sat Aug 15, 12:00 PM — Rena Charles Gallery
item.description:
**ARTIST RECEPTION** Saturday, August 15th, 2026 Noon - 4pm
Some moments cannot be held. A dancer's gesture, fog drifting across the coastline, light changing by the second. In Movement & Stillness, artists Alexis Greenberg and Debra Owen each preserve these fleeting experiences through different mediums. Owen's Degas-inspired multimedia dancers embody grace through line and form, while Greenberg's atmospheric coastal photographs evoke a sense of wanderlust, capturing the ever-changing rhythms of the California coast. Together, they celebrate the beauty of the fleeting and the quiet act of paying attention.
Source: Press Democrat

item.title: Santa Rosa Taco Tuesday Bike Ride — Tue Sep 1, 12:00 AM — SRJC Parking Lot
item.description:
A fun community bike ride through the heart of Santa Rosa. Come join us this Tuesday! We roll through the JC and McDonald Ave neighborhood, stop in Courthouse Square, then on to the taco trucks at Mitote Food Park in Roseland for dinner! We depart Mitote at 8:15pm, ride back through Courthouse Square, then on to Yogurt Farms for dessert. This ride is 8 miles round trip and rides all year long. Rides canceled for rain and holidays. All riders welcome. Bring the whole family! Meet at SRJC parking lot at 550 Silva Ave. We are renting the use of this parking lot every Tuesday from 5:30pm to 9:30 pm. Taco Tuesday riders can park in the lot during that time frame for free. Please park cars along the back wall on the east side. And stage in the row on the northern side of the lot \(closest to Silva Ave\). Meet at 5:30pm; pedals up at 6pm.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Visit Santa Rosa

item.description:
Seasonal Offering Through September 2026
Explore a new dimension of Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc through this seasonal tasting experience. Begin with a glass of the 2025 Yountville Sauvignon Blanc as you’re guided through the cellar, exploring the cigar, puncheon, and barrique barrels used in our Reserve program.
Then, take a seat in our vineyard‑facing salon for a guided exploration of the 2023, 2024, and 2025 Yountville Sauvignon Blanc. Your tasting will conclude with our Reserve Sauvignon Blanc, offering a deeper look at the craft and progression behind this signature wine.
*Tasting fees are applied toward wine purchases.*

Known for her hyper-realistic landscapes, these works take an imaginative turn to the fantastical, tapping into the wild Fauve vivid color palette. Highlighting the show, “Mt. item.title: The Brandlin Estate Wine & Food Tasting Experience — Tue Sep 1, 11:00 AM — Brandlin Estate
item.description:
Born on the rugged slopes of Mount Veeder, Brandlin Estate produces wines of structure, intensity, and place. The Brandlin Experience offers an in-depth exploration of this historic vineyard site through a curated tasting of five estate-grown wines—including Zinfandel from century-old vines and the estate’s signature Cabernet Sauvignon. This seated, guided experience invites guests to delve into the mountain terroir through the lens of small-lot winemaking. Each wine reflects the elevation, exposure, and rocky soils that define the Brandlin Estate. For an added dimension, guests may opt to include seasonal bites, thoughtfully paired to complement the structure and complexity of the wines. This experience is hosted at the picturesque Boathouse.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat
